name: Logo Overlay for WooCommerce
author: dustingunter

sections.description:
Let customers upload and place custom logos onto WooCommerce product images. Ideal for personalized apparel and merch.

Features

  • Upload and preview logos on product images
  • Choose placement visually before adding to cart
  • Generate a merged preview with the uploaded logo
  • Attach merged image to cart and order
  • Optional price bump per customization
  • Auto-cleanup of unused logo files

Localization

  • English (default)
  • Spanish (es_ES)
  • German (es_DE)
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Logo Overlay for WooCommerce.”
  3. Click Install, then Activate.
  4. Enable logo overlay support for specific products via the product editor.
sections.faq:
Can customers adjust logo size or placement?

Yes, users can drag, resize, and preview the logo before adding it to their cart.

Will the logo show up on the order?

Yes. A merged preview is attached to the cart and passed to the order metadata so the merchant can view it.

Can I charge extra for customized products?

Yes. You can enable a price bump per customization in the plugin settings.

What file types are supported?

PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WEBP image formats are supported for uploads.
